conditions: Complex exponential with i the imaginary unit.
spoken_aliases: e raised to the power of open parenthesis i times pi close parenthesis plus one equals zero
e to the power of the quantity i times pi end exponent plus one equals zero
e raised to the power of open parenthesis i pi close parenthesis plus one equals zero

evidence: The complex exponential power series separates into even and odd terms at z=i theta, giving cos(theta)+i sin(theta). Absolute convergence justifies the separation. At theta=pi, cos(pi)=-1 and sin(pi)=0, giving exp(i pi)+1=0.
